was in focus on Thursday as Oppenheimer reiterated its Outperform rating and $450 price target on the stock after a meeting with company management.

"Management indicated the company's out-sized 2H24 bookings ramp coupled with improved cloud migration visibility/activity underpins confidence in SaaS revenue targets," Oppenheimer analyst Ken Wong wrote in a note to clients. "Consistent with our interactions with peers (i3), the underlying budget/demand environment remains consistent. We expect double-digit+ ACV bookings, but anticipate moderation from 2Q levels (20% y/y), after the strong 1H showing, and typical pipeline handicapping. We were reminded of lighter 2H transactional seasonality (in guide). While the buyside questions the level of organic SaaS growth, we view the concern as short-sighted since prospective acquisitions (historically mid-20% CAGR) should eventually be accretive to organic."

title: Tyler Technologies in focus as Oppenheimer reiterates Outperform rating after meeting
